HoldWB.label: Freeze the current settled white balance
HoldWB.purpose: Stop automatic colour drift during paired comparisons; no new colour gains

AutoWB.label: Return to automatic white balance
AutoWB.purpose: Let the camera adapt again; allow settling

Exposure128.label: 128 exposure lines, gain unchanged
Exposure128.purpose: Bracket brightness at fixed sensor gain. Longer exposure may worsen highlight distortion; not a cure.

Exposure192.label: 192 exposure lines, gain unchanged
Exposure192.purpose: Bracket brightness at fixed sensor gain. Longer exposure may worsen highlight distortion; not a cure.

Exposure256.label: 256 exposure lines, gain unchanged
Exposure256.purpose: Bracket brightness at fixed sensor gain. Longer exposure may worsen highlight distortion; not a cure.

Saturation0.label: Espressif saturation level 0
Saturation0.purpose: Published colour matrix, not a percentage increase over our previous unknown/default matrix. Compare level0 first; then restore between trials.

Saturation1.label: Espressif saturation level 1
Saturation1.purpose: Published colour matrix, not a percentage increase over our previous unknown/default matrix. Compare level0 first; then restore between trials.

Saturation2.label: Espressif saturation level 2
Saturation2.purpose: Published colour matrix, not a percentage increase over our previous unknown/default matrix. Compare level0 first; then restore between trials.

GammaReference.label: Espressif gamma0 curve
GammaReference.purpose: Test a published tonal curve without changing exposure/gain. Sensor/ISP enable state still affects response; no guaranteed brightness improvement.

WBOffice.label: Espressif office white-balance preset
WBOffice.purpose: Optional room-lighting comparison if neutral paper is visibly tinted. Not a calibrated match to this room; do not stack with other changes.

limits: No format, clock, pad, voltage or Windows writes
Each apply saves before-values and verified readback; failed transfer stops without retry
Hardware absent during preparation; all trials physically untested
